teaser: A brief for the Web Summit team: an event site run by an ephemeral agent team, from a proven template, with a map of every company to meet.
core_idea: Seven of us go to Web Summit, and the three agent teams stood up this week give a template for an ephemeral team: a repository, a brief, a role and a policy per member, a key per session, hourly slots, five-step wakes, a hold, a board and a mailroom in git, and a gate; the event site consolidates the graph, the events, the materials and a countdown with observability, around a map of companies from public material, while email stays in each person's account with an agent that will sign what it drafts.

quotes.text: The heart of the site is the map of companies going to Web Summit.
If we cannot see what is used, we cannot tell where we add value.
